title: REVA: Reusable Evidence View Aggregation for Context-Efficient RAG Serving
selection_reason: RAGサービングでqueryごとのonline圧縮を繰り返さず、過去のquery-document-model interactionとtarget generatorのattention traceからdocument-keyed reusable evidence viewを構築する。圧縮online overheadを5.3〜15.6倍削減し40ms未満の追加遅延と報告され、context/KVコストをserving側で再利用する実装指向の候補。
instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. Do not infer missing text from abstracts/search snippets. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
completion: Submit the complete workflow-v10 five-slot structured research record and source evidence. If full text is unavailable, return blocked with retrieval evidence instead of guessing.
